dialogues.speaker: Atlahua's Net Advertisement
dialogues.text: "Fishing supplies, ornaments, and all manner of tools — come catch 'em all at Atlahua's Net! Fishing rod-fixing services provided too!"

dialogues.speaker: Atlahua's Net Advertisement
dialogues.text: "We also make custom-made souvenirs, and stuff for your Saurian buddy, too! Our shopkeeper's specialty is improvisation, after all — so come in and have a look. You won't regret it!"
